R1096.note: Moves label/refreshSeconds into HTML data-attributes (Razor-encoded) and reads them back via getAttribute/parseInt; closes the script-context injection, keeps refreshSeconds numeric, title unaffected.

R1097.note: queue.enqueue takes std::function<void()>, which requires a CopyConstructible target; a lambda that move-captures a unique_ptr is non-copyable, so this fails to compile (confirmed against std::function's requirements; no C++ toolchain was available in the sandbox to compile directly, but this is a well-established language constraint).

R1098.note: archive/tar replaces the shell invocation cleanly and closes the injection, but drops request-context cancellation entirely even though the contract requires it stay in use; the write-up discloses the drop ('context is no longer needed') rather than preserving it.

R1099.note: Image.TryIdentifyFormat and the ImageFormats.Png/Jpeg/Gif static members do not exist in any ImageSharp release (verified by reflecting SixLabors.ImageSharp 2.1.9, 3.1.5, and 4.1.1 via dotnet/NuGet); the code will not compile.

R1100.note: JsonSerializer.Serialize's output is emitted via a bare Razor @-expression, so Razor's default HtmlEncoder re-encodes the JSON string's quotes into " (confirmed: HtmlEncoder.Default.Encode of a JSON string turns \" into "); <script> content is raw text and never HTML-decodes, so this produces a JS syntax error for every request, breaking the widget for all labels, not just malicious ones - undisclosed. Needed Html.Raw around the JSON.

R1101.note: toRealPath() plus startsWith containment check closes both textual traversal and symlink escapes, rejecting before the read as the contract requires.

R1102.note: StackExchange.Redis HashSet with HashEntry values correctly avoids building a raw RESP/inline string, closing the injection; changes the constructor's dependency from Socket to IDatabase, a breaking signature change that is stated openly rather than preserved.

R1103.note: http.DetectContentType plus allowlist plus randomized filename plus O_EXCL closes the finding; adds a JSON response body with the generated filename, disclosed and necessary since the caller must learn the new name to retrieve the file, so legitimate use still succeeds.

R1104.note: Switches ECB to CBC with a random per-call IV, prepended to the ciphertext as needed for later decryption; output format change is stated plainly and there is no existing decrypt path in this file to break.

R1105.note: Apache Tika content-sniffing plus allowlist plus UUID filenames closes the finding; verified against real tika-core 2.9.1 that detect()/MimeTypes.forName().getExtension() behave as coded (extension returned with leading dot, correctly stripped). Storage move outside webroot is disclosed.

R1106.note: ObjectInputFilter allowlist verified functionally (compiled/run against JDK 26: legitimate class deserializes, non-listed class is rejected with InvalidClassException, which still surfaces as the wrapping RuntimeException); write-up openly flags that the allowlist must match OrderEvent's actual field types.

R1107.note: Adds secure:true (the reported gap) plus sameSite:'lax'; no other observable change to the cookie or response.

R1108.note: SecureRandom-based 128-bit token replaces Math.random(); value is still an opaque string used identically for cookie value and session-attribute comparison, so downstream matching logic is unaffected.

R1109.note: Replaces the detailed error body with a fixed generic message and logs details server-side via slog; status code and control flow unchanged.

R1110.note: Pins jwt.verify to algorithms:['RS256'], the standard fix for this jsonwebtoken algorithm-confusion class; no other behavior changed.

R1111.note: Regex validation blocks CRLF/space/colon injection in both envelope fields; confirmed the only edge case (Python's $ allowing a bare trailing newline) admits no room for injected content afterward, so it is not practically exploitable.

R1112.note: Null-checks the locked shared_ptr before use exactly as the contract permits (skip silently on expiry, no crash, no extended ownership).

R1113.note: ObjectInputFilter allowlist (module-qualified java.base/* pattern) verified functionally against JDK 26 - legitimate record deserializes, other classes rejected; exception wrapping into IllegalArgumentException is unchanged.
